title: Funeral Program Template – Easy Fill‑In PDF for a Gentle Service
description: Learn how to personalize and print a simple funeral program template. Step‑by‑step guide with printable sizes, editing tips, and printing options.
h1: How to Use a Funeral Program Template
intro: A funeral program template gives you a ready‑made layout that you can fill in on your phone or computer, then print at home or a local shop. It provides a comforting way to share the order of service, life story, and thank‑you notes with guests.

sections.h2: What Does a Funeral Program Template Include?
paragraphs: Our Soft Botanical suite provides a four‑panel program that folds to a 5.5 × 8.5 in booklet. The front cover welcomes guests, the inside panels hold the order of service, a short life story, and a thank‑you/reception note. All pages are formatted for standard US Letter paper (11 × 8.5 in) so you can print on any home or office printer.
bullets: Cover – gentle botanical design with space for a photo and name
Order of Service – timeline of the ceremony
Life Story – brief biography or favorite memories
Thank‑You/Reception – gratitude and reception details

sections.h2: How to Personalize the Template on a Phone or Computer
paragraphs: Open the PDF in the free Adobe Acrobat Reader app (available for iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS). Tap any sample text, type your information, and use the built‑in Save function. On a computer you can also add a photo by selecting the image placeholder and choosing a file from your hard drive.
bullets: Download the PDF
Open in Adobe Acrobat Reader
Tap or click each text box and type
Add a photo (computer only)
Save the file

paragraphs: Print the saved PDF on 80‑100 lb cardstock for a sturdy booklet. Choose “Landscape” orientation, select “Fit to Page,” and print double‑sided if your printer supports it. After printing, fold the sheet in half to create the 5.5 × 8.5 in program.
bullets: Use US Letter (8.5 × 11 in) paper
Select cardstock for durability
Print double‑sided, landscape
Fold in half to form the booklet

sections.h2: Printing at a Local Shop (Staples, Office Depot, FedEx)
paragraphs: If you prefer a professional finish, bring the saved PDF file on a USB drive or email it to the store. Ask for the program printed on 100 lb cardstock, double‑sided, and cut to the exact size. Many shops can also mount the welcome sign on foam board for a polished entry display.
bullets: Save PDF to USB or email
Request 100 lb cardstock, double‑sided
Ask for a clean cut to 5.5 × 8.5 in
Mount the welcome sign on foam board (optional)

sections.h2: When to Use the Full Soft Botanical Suite
paragraphs: If you need a matching welcome sign (24 × 36 in) and share‑a‑memory cards (4.25 × 5.5 in), the Soft Botanical suite bundles everything for $12.99. The sign prints at the same 2:3 ratio, so you can also produce it at 16 × 24 in or 12 × 18 in without redesign. The memory cards let guests write short tributes that you can collect during the service.
bullets: Welcome sign – prints at 24 × 36 in (or smaller)
Share‑a‑memory cards – four per sheet
All items share the same gentle botanical theme

faq.q: Can I edit a funeral program template without paying for software?
faq.a: Yes. The PDF can be edited with the free Adobe Acrobat Reader app on any phone, tablet, or computer—no subscription or design program needed.

faq.q: What paper size should I use for the program?
faq.a: Print on standard US Letter (8.5 × 11 in) paper; after folding, the booklet measures 5.5 × 8.5 in.

faq.q: Do I need to print the program double‑sided?
faq.a: Double‑sided printing gives a professional look and saves paper, but you can also print one side, then manually flip and print the back if your printer lacks duplex capability.

faq.q: Can I add a photo to the program?
faq.a: Photos can be added on a computer by clicking the image placeholder in Adobe Reader. The mobile app does not support image insertion.

faq.q: How quickly can I have the program printed?
faq.a: If you print at home, it’s ready within minutes after saving. At a local print shop, most stores can finish the job the same day.
